stories.title: Domestically produced Russian high speed train to be tested in 2027
stories.summary: Ural Locomotives is developing the EVS360 Bely Krechet high-speed trainset, with Russian Railways expecting delivery for testing during 2027. The project covers 43 eight-car trainsets for the Moskva – St Petersburg line, with commercial services planned to start in April 2028.

stories.title: Denver Roads to See Increase in Autonomous Vehicles
stories.summary: Waymo plans to expand its passenger vehicles to all of metro Denver and Denver International Airport in the coming months, while other operators prepare to launch driverless services in the city.

also.title: Waymo soon will be joined in Denver by self-driving trucks, other autonomous vehicles

stories.title: Dubai certifies second vertiport for Joby air taxi service
stories.summary: Skyports Infrastructure received approval from the UAE’s General Civil Aviation Authority for its Dubai Marina vertiport, completing infrastructure for the first Joby Aviation route. The facility supports up to 21,000 landings annually, with commercial operations targeted for 2027 pending aircraft certification.

also.title: Dubai Marina Vertiport Certified Ahead of Planned Joby Air Taxi Services

stories.title: Waymo suspends San Francisco robotaxi operations due to street flooding
stories.summary: Waymo paused its San Francisco robotaxi service around 11 AM local time after heavy rain and street flooding left autonomous vehicles stranded in traffic. The company stated it will restart rides when road conditions improve and the forecast looks clear.

also.title: Waymo robotaxi pause during San Francisco storm

stories.title: Marine Corps Order Covers Printed Drones, Sentinel Sells The Factory
U.S. Army to stress test its depots with cheap attack drone production
Feedback Framework Boosts Autonomous Vehicle Decision Making in Complex
stories.summary: Researchers introduced FEDrive-LLM, a feedback-enhanced closed-loop framework for autonomous driving decision making that combines continuous online verification with reflective assessment mechanisms. In experimental simulation benchmarks, the system achieved marked improvements in mission success rates, reduced required operational steps, and sustained higher average driving speeds compared to existing state-of-the-art navigation methods.

stories.title: Amtrak orders longer Airo trains to increase capacity in the Northeast Corridor
stories.summary: Amtrak awarded Siemens Mobility a contract to supply eight rakes of Airo coaches and modernise 18 ACS-64 electric locomotives for Northeast Regional services in the Northeast Corridor.

stories.title: Archer and ForeFlight Begin Integrating AI-Powered ATC Transcription into Flight App
Mountmellick man is one of Ireland’s first robotic apprentices
stories.summary: Cian Barber, a Mountmellick man, is one of nine apprentices in LMETB’s first robotic and automation intake at its Dundalk training centre. The program, developed by an industry consortium and validated by Quality and Qualifications Ireland, offers a pathway to the third year of a degree at Southern Regional College in Armagh.

stories.title: Delhi-Ahmedabad Bullet Train Awaits Project Sanction
stories.summary: The Delhi-Ahmedabad high-speed rail corridor remains at the planning stage without project sanction or construction, according to an Economic Times report. The proposed 886-km route would connect 15 stations across Delhi, Haryana, Rajasthan, and Gujarat, potentially reducing travel time between the two cities to less than four hours.

stories.title: FREQUENTIS powers one of the world's first open-market drone ecosystems as Australia rolls out digital UTM services
stories.summary: Frequentis developed a Flight Information Management System for Airservices Australia, which transitioned into live operations at the end of October. The system supports the country's Uncrewed Aircraft System Traffic Management ecosystem, enabling multiple service providers to connect to a common digital infrastructure for drone flight approvals.

also.title: Airservices launches new drone traffic management system

stories.title: Bolt and Stellantis plan autonomous vehicle trials in Greater Paris from 2028
stories.summary: Bolt, Stellantis and Métropole du Grand Paris announced plans to introduce autonomous mobility services in Greater Paris from 2028, with an initial pilot covering up to five municipalities and potential expansion to more than 30 municipalities by 2030. The project, called the Greater Paris Autonomous Driving Living Lab, has been submitted to the European Commission’s Autonomous Drive Ambition Cities (ADACities) initiative.

stories.title: Florida's $2.5M DFR Drone Fund Claimed in 15 Days; Bradenton Got $25K
stories.summary: Bradenton, Florida approved a $25,000 state grant on November 18 to help its police department buy two more Skydio X10 drones. The money comes from the Florida Department of Law Enforcement’s new Drone as First Responder (DFR) grant program, a $2.5 million fund for the 2026-27 fiscal year.

stories.title: USDA Rail Data: Container Carloads Dominate Major U.S. Carriers
stories.summary: USDA data for the week ending November 14, 2026, shows container traffic as the leading commodity category for major U.S. railroads, with BNSF recording the highest total value at 204,734. BNSF also led originated container traffic with 104,326 carloads, ahead of UP at 70,582 and NS at 63,876.

stories.title: ePlane Selects Lynx Software Platform for e200X eVTOL Computing
inDrive and Pony.ai plan robotaxi services in Kazakhstan
stories.summary: inDrive signed a memorandum of understanding with Pony.ai and Nvidia to explore Level 4 autonomous taxi services in Kazakhstan, identifying Astana as the first potential market. The companies will assess technical, operational, regulatory, and commercial feasibility, with Pony.ai supplying seventh-generation robotaxis, inDrive operating the service, and Nvidia providing AI computing infrastructure.

stories.title: Top Key Players KUKA AG; Mitsubishi Electric, Industrial Robot Controller Market to Reach USD 3.1 Billion by 2
stories.summary: Future Market Insights estimates the global industrial robot controller market will grow from USD 1.3 billion in 2026 to USD 3.1 billion by 2036, registering a compound annual growth rate of 9.1%.

stories.title: ACUASI director highlights recent updates, potential for drones
stories.summary: Cathy Cahill, director for the Alaska Center for UAS Integration UAF, provided an update on the drone program on Tuesday. ACUASI plans to equip its two Windracer drones with a Detect and Avoid radar system, a critical step needed for drones to operate beyond the line of visual sight.

stories.title: Air taxi developers begin passenger flights under strict FAA guidance
stories.summary: Archer Aviation and Beta Technologies began passenger flights after the Federal Aviation Administration issued each a Special Airworthiness Market Survey Certificate. Beta flies in upstate New York and Vermont, while Archer focuses on Los Angeles, as Joby Aviation applies for the same certificate.

stories.title: DJI M30 Flies for Texas Police Unit That Found Missing Boy, 14
stories.summary: The Garland Police Department drone unit found a missing 14-year-old boy with autism under dense tree cover on Oct. 29. A police drone pilot picked up his heat signature in the woods and guided officers on foot to him.

stories.title: Transit Milestones: Electric Bus Base, Portal North Bridge, Hanford Viaduct, and Hitachi Rail Hub
stories.summary: King County Metro completed Tukwila Base on November 4, its first 100 percent battery-electric bus base in Washington state. NJ TRANSIT and Amtrak announced on November 16 that both tracks of the new Portal North Bridge are in full service, removing a longstanding cause of delays for approximately 450 trains crossing the Northeast Corridor each weekday.

stories.title: Canada – Counter uncrewed aerial systems (urban) sandbox 2027
stories.summary: IDEaS is seeking solutions to detect, track, and identify micro and mini uncrewed aerial systems in an urban environment. From July 26 to 30, 2027, demonstrate your cutting-edge technology in the heart of downtown Ottawa, Ontario.

also.title: Canada Opens Ottawa Counter-Drone Sandbox With $1.75M in Prizes
Canadian defence sandbox invites industry to demonstrate C-UAS tech in Ottawa

stories.title: Hanwha Systems wins first US contract for counter-drone radar
stories.summary: Hanwha Systems secured its first US radar export contract by agreeing to supply short-range active electronically scanned array radars to Rebellion Industries. Deliveries will occur in stages through early 2027, with initial deployment at civilian infrastructure sites including oil refineries and stadiums.

stories.title: First Shift: Port labor risk, component standards and robotics reshape operating priorities
stories.summary: The American Trucking Associations proposed third-party electronic-logging-device certification modeled partly on Canada’s system, seeking stronger testing, lifecycle oversight and data checks after federal regulators accelerated device revocations.

stories.title: Amazon Drone Passed Over Paramotor Wing on Landing, Idaho Pilot Says
stories.summary: Mike Cunningham told Idaho News 6 that an Amazon Prime Air delivery drone passed over the top of his wing while he was about 30 feet off the ground. Amazon told the station its drones can detect and avoid other aircraft on their own, including paragliders that carry no transponder.

stories.title: Tesla Opens Orders for Its $29,990 Cybercab in Texas, Then Musk Says the $299 Monthly Fee It Needs to Move Is ‘Too High’
stories.summary: Tesla began inviting select customers on Nov. 13 to order a Cybercab for personal use at $29,990 in Texas, with an Autonomy Subscription at $299 a month that is “required to operate.” Elon Musk said the monthly fee is “too high” and should match the cost of Tesla FSD and connectivity for other models, which is more like ~$115/month.

also.title: Tesla's Cybercab raises concerns among automakers and battery suppliers

stories.title: Aspen Fire Trains to Use AI-Guided Firefighting Drones
Two FAA-Licensed Spaceports Propose 250-Mile Supersonic Test Corridor Across West Texas and New Mexico
stories.summary: Midland International Air & Space Port and the New Mexico Spaceport Authority are partnering with Starfighters Space to develop a 250-nautical-mile supersonic test corridor across West Texas and southern New Mexico. The parties are working under a letter of intent to create a regulated alternative to special flight authorizations as the FAA moves toward ending its supersonic ban.

also.title: US firms seek new 250-mile speed lane for supersonic-hypersonic flight tests
Midland and New Mexico Spaceports Team Up on 250-Nautical-Mile Supersonic Test Corridor
Supersonic jets in US could get dedicated 250-mile corridor for repeated tests

stories.title: No Train, No Problem?
ORR Authorises Bristol Brabazon Station for Passenger Services
stories.summary: The Office of Rail and Road (ORR) authorised Bristol Brabazon station to begin passenger services on Monday, 23 November. The new station will restore passenger services to the Henbury Line for the first time since 1964, offering an initial hourly service operated by Great Western Railway (GWR) with connections to Bristol Temple Meads.

stories.title: Supersonic jets want a comeback. But can Americans stand the boom?
stories.summary: In 1971, Congress cut off funding for the SST, and two years later the FAA banned civilian supersonic flight over U.S. soil. Today, prompted by a 2025 executive order, the FAA is proposing to lift that ban before any community response tests of emerging supersonic technology have taken place.

stories.title: Machina Aims to Democratize Car Customization with Innovative Robots
stories.summary: Machina Labs launched Machina Rebellis to provide automakers with a flexible metal manufacturing process that skips costly retooling for limited-production models. The company demonstrated its RoboCraftsman platform by building the Lassen, a customized Toyota Tacoma, in two and a half weeks, a task that typically takes four to six months via traditional methods.

stories.title: Delhi-Mumbai bullet train in under 6 hours? 15 stations, 4 states and one missing link in India's high-spe
stories.summary: The article does not contain information about the Delhi-Mumbai bullet train project, its 15 stations, 4 states, or target travel time.

stories.title: SkyDrive and Kyushu Electric Power explore eVTOL integration into urban development
stories.summary: SkyDrive and Kyushu Electric Power signed a partnership agreement on 18 November to explore integrating electric vertical take-off and landing aircraft into urban development and regional mobility planning. The collaboration will assess eVTOL applications in community planning, develop operational frameworks, and identify initiatives to address regional transport challenges and support local economic development.

stories.title: Allies announce new air-defence and drone support commitment to Ukraine at 37th Ramstein meeting
stories.summary: International partners announced new funding and equipment for Ukraine’s air defence and counter-drone capabilities following the 37th Ukraine Defense Contact Group meeting in Brussels on 17 November. The support packages include Ukrainian interceptor drones, systems to counter jet-powered Shahed drones, air defence missiles, radars and funding for domestic drone production, according to Ukraine’s Ministry of Defence.

stories.title: HENSOLDT partners with ZF to expand production of Spexer counter-drone radars
stories.summary: HENSOLDT signed a cooperation agreement with ZF Friedrichshafen AG on 18 November to expand production capacity for its Spexer radar family. ZF will establish a scalable series production facility and develop an automated testing system, while HENSOLDT retains all intellectual property rights.

also.title: HENSOLDT Hands Spexer Drone-Defence Radar Production to ZF

stories.title: Florida Dentist Accused of Drone Stalking Ex-Wife, Hiding the Drone
stories.summary: Palm Beach County sheriff’s deputies arrested Jacques Benchimol, 45, after following a drone to his location near his ex-wife’s home in West Boca Raton on November 9. Benchimol faces three charges, including cyberstalking and drone surveillance, and allegedly concealed the drone in a gray Mercedes when he noticed the officers.

stories.title: Knoxville Police Drones Launch With a Ban on Face and Plate Scans
stories.summary: The Knoxville Police Department started flying Skydio drones from 12 docks on November 19 to respond to 911 calls. The department's policy states that drones do not perform facial recognition or collect ALPR data.

stories.title: From Berlin to Brussels: Tesla's $3.3 Billion Robotaxi Gamble
stories.summary: Tesla committed approximately $3.3 billion to expand its Berlin facility to produce up to one million autonomous Cybercabs annually starting in 2029, despite current European Union rules limiting fully driverless car registrations to 1,500 units per model each year.

stories.title: At Apple, the robots are coming
stories.summary: An Industrial Automation 2026 report claims US manufacturing has spent $51 billion on robotics and automation this year, with spending expected to exceed $84 billion by 2030. The report states global industrial robot stock hit roughly 5.0 million units in 2025, up 9% year-over-year, while annual installations topped 600,000 units, up 11%.

stories.title: Heavy Haul Conference 2026: Collaboration Key to Unlocking Rail Capacity in Multi-Operator Environment
stories.summary: A panel at the South African Heavy Haul Association Conference 2026 in Gauteng on November 18 stated that greater collaboration among infrastructure managers, freight operators, mining companies and port terminals is needed to unlock rail capacity in a multi-operator environment.

stories.title: Valkryn Emerges From Stealth To Test Autonomous Military Systems
stories.summary: Valkryn emerged from stealth to develop test environments and evaluation software for drones, robots, and autonomous defense systems. The company aims to replace fragmented testing processes with standardized evidence of system performance in realistic conditions.

stories.title: Ukraine plans to double drone supplies, triple deep strikes
stories.summary: Ukraine plans to double its drone supplies and more than triple its long-range strike capabilities next year, according to Defense Minister Yevhenii Khmara. The British government will send Ukraine more than 1,000 long-range strike drones in a roughly $342 million package, while Germany pledged to buy jointly produced drones and Norway promised $300 million for Ukrainian drones.

stories.title: Tesla Cybercab Spec Page Shows 279-Mile Range, 123 Miles in 15 Minutes
stories.summary: Tesla rates its Cybercab at 279 miles of EPA-estimated range and says Supercharging adds 123 miles in 15 minutes, according to the specifications page on the order site shown to customers invited to buy the two-seater for personal use.

stories.title: Army Trains 1st Cavalry Artillery To Ram Drones With Bumblebee V2
stories.summary: Joint Interagency Task Force 401 trained 1st Cavalry Division Artillery soldiers on the Bumblebee V2 quadcopter at Fort Hood, Texas, from November 2 to 13. The Pentagon’s counter-drone task force announced the exercise on November 18, describing the aircraft as a dual-use system for reconnaissance and kinetic interception.

stories.title: 10,000 trains and counting: China's auto export rail service picks up speed
stories.summary: A train carrying 203 domestically made new energy vehicles departed from Zhengzhou International Land Port on Thursday, marking the milestone of 10,000 special trains for exported finished vehicles transported by dedicated rail wagons. Since the start of this year, more than 2.035 million finished vehicles have been exported via rail, a 79% year-on-year increase.

stories.title: Stanford Gave 100 Students 48 Hours to Fly a Drone With No GPS
stories.summary: Stanford University hosted its first drone hackathon from November 6 to 8, where 100 students from 28 universities spent 48 hours writing software to fly quadcopters through an indoor obstacle course without GPS. A five-person team named Fat Kestrel won the $7,000 top prize after their drone successfully completed the course and returned to the start.

stories.title: Blysk Anti-Drone Laser System Enters Combat Duty in Kyiv, Carmine Sky Says
stories.summary: Ukrainian defense company Carmine Sky deployed its Blysk laser system in Kyiv in early November to counter Russian attack drones. The 4 kW system has a stated engagement range of up to one kilometre and did not engage targets during its first few days due to cloudy and foggy weather.

stories.title: Imagry and Endera to Introduce First Buy America-Compliant Autonomous Buses and Shuttles
stories.summary: Imagry announced a partnership with Endera to deliver the first Buy America-compliant autonomous buses and shuttles for US public transit. The companies will pair Imagry’s Level 4 autonomous driving system with Endera’s American-built vehicles to provide self-driving options purchasable entirely with federal transit funds.

stories.title: KNDS launches AI-based FENNEK AIR mobile counter-UAS prototype at NEDS
stories.summary: KNDS Deutschland is presenting a prototype of FENNEK AIR, an artificial intelligence-enabled mobile counter-uncrewed aircraft system vehicle, at the NIDV Exhibition Defence & Security in Rotterdam, Netherlands, on 19 November. The vehicle is equipped with KNDS France’s ARX30 remote-controlled weapon station and a 30 mm automatic cannon configured for counter-drone missions.

also.title: KNDS Shows AI Counter-Drone FENNEK AIR Prototype at NEDS
KNDS Fennek Air counter-drone prototype combines AI decision support with a 30 mm cannon

stories.title: Bi-mode locomotives to be ordered amid lukewarm response to French night train fleet renewal tenders
stories.summary: The French national government agreed to order new bi-mode locomotives from Stadler through Alpha Trains to power domestic overnight passenger trains in the Trains d’Équilibre du Territoire network.

stories.title: Amtrak Joins Texas Central on Dallas-Houston Rail
stories.summary: Amtrak and Texas Central are evaluating a partnership to study a proposed 390 km high-speed rail line between Dallas and Houston, which would operate at up to 330 km/h using Shinkansen technology. The companies have applied for federal support through three grant programmes, with decisions and the outcome of the Amtrak evaluation remaining pending.

stories.title: Forsyth County Sheriff establishes first U.S. A2Z AirDock network, expanding drone-as-first-responder capabilities
stories.summary: A2Z Drone Delivery announced that the Forsyth County Sheriff’s Office launched the nation’s first A2Z AirDock network, enabling a fleet of Longtail Patrol drones to cover up to 200 square miles around Winston-Salem, NC. The automated docking stations support rapid deployment for search-and-rescue, criminal investigations, and AED delivery, having flown more than 500 miles in its initial weeks.

also.title: Forsyth County Establishes US Public Safety Network of Automated Drone Docks

stories.title: China Develops Military Drone That Fires Painkiller Darts at Wounded Troops
stories.summary: China's Air Force Medical University developed the first casualty-search drone for the People's Liberation Army, which fires darts loaded with painkillers to treat wounded soldiers from a distance. The system aims to keep medical teams out of harm's way and buy critical time for further treatment.

stories.title: Top Robotics And Industrial Automation Startups In Estonia To Watch In 2027
stories.summary: Estonian robotics startups raised €93 million in equity funding in 2026, making it the country’s top sector by capital raised. The funding supports diverse applications, including Milrem Robotics’ unmanned ground vehicles for military use and Starship Technologies’ self-driving sidewalk delivery robots.

stories.title: LASE to Premiere Quantum Bullet(TM) at Counter UAS Technology Conference in Washington, D.C.
stories.summary: LASE Corp. will premiere its Quantum Bullet™ anti-drone platform at Counter UAS Technology USA in Washington, D.C., from November 30 through December 2, 2026. Executive Chairman Dmitri Nikitin will present as a featured speaker at the event, which brings together military, government, and industry leaders to address unmanned aerial system threats.

stories.title: Arrive AI Robot Adds Daily Specimen Runs at Hancock Health Lab
stories.summary: Arrive AI announced that Hancock Health is adding a second Arrive Point receiving unit at its Parkway Building in Greenfield, Indiana. An autonomous ground robot will make four to five scheduled runs a day carrying specimens to the Hancock Regional Hospital laboratory, with on-demand trips for urgent orders.

stories.title: US company Poseidon Aerospace cuts Egret military cargo drone development by 18 months using AI
stories.summary: Flexcompute announced on November 17, 2026, that its partnership with Poseidon Aerospace shortened the development schedule of the Egret P50-E-01 and Heron P50-H-01 autonomous cargo aircraft by 18 months using AI-assisted simulations. The collaboration reduced aerodynamic database creation from eight months to three weeks and enabled ten times more simulations, supporting planned full-scale flight testing for commercial and U.S. military logistics.

stories.title: US Air Force Drone Lockdown Was Three Small Planes, Pilot Says
stories.summary: Ferry pilot Sam Rutherford told the BBC that three Cirrus SR20 light aircraft he was flying in were mistaken for drones during a lockdown at RAF Lakenheath on November 13. Moldova’s Civil Aviation Authority confirmed two days later that three SR20s arriving from the Czech Republic were filmed and shared online as drones over Chișinău.

stories.title: Zipline launches drone delivery service for Uber Eats customers in Houston
stories.summary: Zipline launched autonomous drone deliveries for Uber Eats customers in Houston on 17 November, allowing users to select the “by drone” option in the app. The service, which uses aircraft flying at approximately 330 feet to deliver payloads of up to eight pounds, will initially serve Houston before expanding to Dallas and additional US cities.
